description: A React component named Timestamp that provides rich date/time formatting with support for relative times, semantic output, and fallback to moment.js for unsupported timezones. It uses react-intl for internationalization and includes utility functions for date calculations.

classes.name: Timestamp
classes.description: A React component that displays formatted timestamps with support for relative times, semantic output, and fallback formatting.

methods.name: is12HourTime
methods.description: Determines if the time should be formatted in 12-hour format based on hourCycle and hour12 options.

methods.name: formatParts
methods.description: Generates formatted parts (relative, date, time) for a given date value based on formats.

methods.name: formatRelative
methods.description: Formats a date as a relative time string.

methods.name: formatDateTime
methods.description: Formats a date using Intl.DateTimeFormat with specified options.

methods.name: momentTime
methods.description: Formats a Moment object into a time string based on options.

methods.name: momentDate
methods.description: Formats a Moment object into a date string based on options.

methods.name: autoRange
methods.description: Determines the display range descriptor based on the date value.

methods.name: getFormats
methods.description: Determines the formats (relative, date, time) to use for a given date.

methods.name: maybeUpdate
methods.description: Schedules the next update for relative time display.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Static method to combine formatted parts into a ReactNode.

methods.name: formatLabel
methods.description: Creates a label string for a date, optionally including timezone info.
